primary.usage: FilledButton, active navigation icon and label (light), active page dot (light). Same value in both themes. As text on `surface`: light 6.43:1; dark 3.01:1, so dark text in `primary` only at 18sp+ or 14sp bold.

on-primary.usage: Text and icons on `primary` and `surfaceTint` (6.43:1 both themes).

primary-container.usage: FAB, soft emphasis. Equals `primary` here (fidelity keeps the seed), so do not place it next to a FilledButton.

primary-fixed.usage: Decorative top-of-page glow in light (left stop). Same in both themes.

secondary-container.usage: Chip. NavigationBar has no indicator. Never a button background.

secondary-fixed.usage: Fixed secondary step, same in both themes.

tertiary.usage: Third accent. Not used on the reviewed screens.

error.usage: Error borders and messages, notification badge; StatusBanner icon, text and its 16% tint.

error-container.usage: Cancelled state tags. Not for StatusBanner, which uses a 16% tint of `error`.

surface.usage: Page background (Scaffold). Light is pure white; dark is the anchored navy.

on-surface.usage: Primary text on `surface`, `cardSurface`, `searchSurface`; active navigation icon and label (dark); active page dot (dark). 17.10:1 light, 15.00:1 dark.

surface-dim.usage: Lowest step of the surface ladder.

surface-bright.usage: Highest-brightness step of the surface ladder.

surface-container-lowest.usage: Card and search bar in light (via `cardSurface`, `searchSurface`).

surface-container.usage: Divider in dark (via `divider`). NavigationBar uses `surface`, not this.

surface-container-high.usage: Card in dark (via `cardSurface`); divider in light; dark top glow.

surface-container-highest.usage: Progress track and countdown ring track. Search bar in dark (via searchSurface). Not for text fields: in light it is a neutral grey.

on-surface-variant.usage: Secondary text, secondary icons, inactive navigation labels. On `surface`: 9.40:1 light, 11.36:1 dark.

outline.usage: Text field border, inactive page dots (dark). 3:1+ on surface and cardSurface.

outline-variant.usage: Card and MatchTile border in dark, inactive page dots (light). Not for divider lines: use `divider`.

shadow.usage: Shadows. Light cards and search bar use it at 8% opacity (`shadow-raised`).

success.usage: Status icons and text in success state; filled status buttons; StatusBanner icon, text and its 16% tint.

success-container.usage: Progress bar value; success tags. Same in both themes. Not for StatusBanner, which uses a 16% tint of `success-color`.

warning.usage: Status icons and text in warning state; filled status buttons.

warning-container.usage: Warning tags and banners. Same in both themes.

info.usage: Status icons and text in info state; filled status buttons.

info-container.usage: Deck icon in dark (on `tileSurface`); info tags and banners. Same in both themes.

card-surface.usage: Card background. Cards are raised by tone, not shadow (M3 tonal elevation): light is primary at 8% over surface (#ffffff), dark is surfaceContainerHigh. No shadow and no border in either theme.

search-surface.usage: SearchBar background, same tone as cardSurface. No shadow.

tile-surface.usage: Background of the 64 × 64 deck icon tile (`size-tile`). Light also feeds the right stop of the top glow. Source: info palette tone 97 in light, secondary palette tone 24 in dark.

divider.usage: Hairline dividers, top border of NavigationBar. Source: surfaceContainerHigh in light, surfaceContainer in dark.

display-term.purpose: The word being studied on a flashcard (Flutter displaySmall). onSurface on cardSurface, centered, one line. Regular weight, as on the reference screen.

term-tile.purpose: Korean word inside a MatchTile (Flutter headlineSmall). onSurface on cardSurface, centered, max 2 lines.

display-stat.purpose: Key numbers that replace a sentence: due count, stat values (Flutter displayMedium). Numbers only, never words.

title-section.purpose: Section headings on a screen (Flutter titleLarge). onSurface on surface.

title-card.purpose: Card titles and key numbers in compact stats (Flutter titleMedium). onSurface on cardSurface. Max 2 lines.

title-item.purpose: Item and row titles: deck name, ActionRow label, card header row (Flutter titleSmall). onSurface. Max 2 lines.

body-content.purpose: Card content the learner reads: meaning on Review, Recall and Fill cards (Flutter bodyLarge). onSurface on cardSurface. Kept at 16 for reading; interface copy uses body.

body.purpose: Interface copy: list subtitles, hints next to an icon (Flutter bodyMedium). onSurfaceVariant for subtitles.

body-tile.purpose: Meaning text inside a MatchTile, on MatchScreen and as answer options on GuessScreen (Flutter bodySmall). onSurface on cardSurface, centered, max 7 lines.

label-button.purpose: Button labels in both Button sizes (Flutter labelLarge). onPrimary on primary. Regular weight: button text is not bold.

label-meta.purpose: Progress text, search placeholder, banner message, counts (Flutter labelMedium). onSurfaceVariant.

label-nav.purpose: NavigationBar labels (Flutter labelSmall). primary when selected in light, onSurface when selected in dark, onSurfaceVariant otherwise.

shadows.name: shadow-raised
shadows.purpose: Kept for compatibility and set to none: cards and the search bar are raised by tone (cardSurface, searchSurface). Do not add shadows to cards.

motion.name: motion-easing-standard
motion.purpose: Small, utility moves that start and end on screen (color, opacity changes).

motion.name: motion-easing-standard-accelerate
motion.purpose: Small elements leaving the screen, e.g. a matched MatchTile fading out.

motion.name: motion-easing-emphasized
motion.purpose: Expressive moves that start and end on screen: card swipe in ReviewScreen, page transitions. Flutter Easing.emphasizedDecelerate/Accelerate pair or Curves.easeInOutCubicEmphasized.

motion.name: motion-easing-emphasized-decelerate
motion.purpose: Expressive enter: next card or screen arriving.

motion.name: motion-easing-emphasized-accelerate
motion.purpose: Expressive exit: card or screen leaving.

motion.name: motion-easing-linear
motion.purpose: Only for progress over time, such as the 15 s countdown ring.

motion.name: motion-duration-short2
motion.purpose: Selection and state-layer changes (tile selected, hover, pressed).

motion.name: motion-duration-short3
motion.purpose: State color changes on tiles (MatchTile selected, correct, incorrect).

motion.name: motion-duration-short4
motion.purpose: Small exits and fades: matched MatchTile fade-out, banner dismiss.

motion.name: motion-duration-medium2
motion.purpose: Small enters and component expand: banner appear, indicator pill move.

motion.name: motion-duration-medium4
motion.purpose: Card swipe and page transitions; also the hold time after a correct answer.

motion.name: motion-duration-long4
motion.purpose: Large transitions; also the hold time after a wrong match before tiles reset.

narrative.overview: MemoX should feel like a quiet, focused study space. One structure ships a light and a dark theme, both generated from design/tokens.json: a calm page, cards raised by tone alone, and one accent that means "act". Component philosophy: "Calm and exact".
keyCharacteristics: One sans family (Be Vietnam Pro, with Noto Sans KR for Korean), twelve Material roles used as the tokens define them.
Tonal surfaces: cardSurface, searchSurface and tileSurface sit on surface with no edge and no shadow.
One accent rule: context.accentColor for accent text and glyphs, primary for fills, edges and indicators.
Phone first, context.screenMargin at the screen edge, sizeControl touch targets everywhere.
Every text and edge pair is contrast-tested in both themes; the pairs below AA are recorded in design/contrast_exceptions.json.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent means "act". A primary fill appears once per decision; the rest of the screen is neutral.

rules.name: The Green Means Progress Rule
rules.body: Green is success or successContainer and nothing else; green is never decoration.

rules.name: The Text Colour Rule
rules.body: Text and glyphs read a text role, never a fill; a control edge reads outline, a hairline divider or outlineVariant, focus primary.

rules.name: The Tint Rule
rules.body: A tinted ground is a role tinted over the surface beneath it with tintOver; nothing else lays a colour over a ground at an alpha.

rules.name: The Mode Rule
rules.body: A widget never chooses a colour or a size by brightness; theme_rules.dart holds every rule that differs by mode.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Text holds 4.5:1 and non-text 3:1; the pairs below the floor are the entries of design/contrast_exceptions.json.

rules.name: The Twelve Roles Rule
rules.body: Screens use the twelve type roles and change only their colour or switch to the mono face.

rules.name: The Text Grows Rule
rules.body: Text scale is never clamped and no fixed height wraps text.

rules.name: The Touch Floor Rule
rules.body: Painted size never sets the touch area; every control keeps a sizeControl square hit area.

rules.name: The Footer Pair Rule
rules.body: Two footer actions share the row while both labels fit; otherwise they stack full width.

rules.name: The Tone Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Group with tone first; a surface that does not float never casts a shadow and never draws an edge.

dos: Do take every value from design/tokens.json through the generated theme.
Do use primary for exactly one primary action per decision and context.accentColor for accent text and glyphs.
Do keep the contrast test green, with every exception recorded.
Do guarantee a sizeControl touch area on every interactive element, and let text containers grow.
Do write failure copy in the local-first voice: say first that nothing was lost, then offer the retry.
Do use the spacing scale and context.screenMargin rather than ad-hoc values.
donts: Don't write a hex code, a size or a duration in a widget, a test or a document; name the token.
Don't use a fill as text; use its text role.
Don't branch on brightness in a widget or lay a colour over a ground at an alpha.
Don't give a card or the search field a border or a shadow.
Don't restyle a text role beyond its colour or the mono face.
Don't declare a removed theme name again in any form.
